name: Gradovi i općine Hrvatske (OSM)
title: Gradovi i općine Hrvatske (OSM)
description: OSM-derived list of all 532 jedinica lokalne samouprave (gradovi i općine) in Croatia at admin_level=7. Each record carries the OSM relation id, the administrative name (Općina X / Grad Y), the OSM parent-relation chain (which encodes the županija → država hierarchy), and the centroid (lat/lon) plus bounding box computed from the original polygon. Source GeoJSON is published by Code for Croatia under the OSMB redistribution snapshot of OpenStreetMap administrative boundaries — ODbL-1.0, OpenStreetMap contributors must be credited.
